notes.title: After a year and a half of being in early access, the game is released!
notes.content:

notes.title: A small trailer presenting the features of the new version of the game
notes.content:
Grab your revolver, spur your horse and prove to all the thugs that you are the best shooter in the entire Wild West! Exciting adventures, dynamic shootouts, chases, robberies and duels await you.

[previewyoutube=rJ7krYWOOHk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gameplay video and new screenshots
notes.content:
Today I'm ready to show you the first gameplay video of the updated version of the game. It shows the passage of the level from the introduction of the game.

[previewyoutube=lbvZ02d9z7M;full][/previewyoutube]

I also decided on the genre - a dynamic shooter with a top-down view and roguelite elements.

At the moment, all the main mechanics are ready, the next stage is the development of levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/8aa46819a8926fc912c5773fed0ad69ca7228831.jpg[/img]

Also, the mechanics of the duel with mini-bosses are already ready, it is simple, but can make you sweat

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/d66a5487569197ee81a446f90f961b65a11015cc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/6e2f694a4dfbe976712eb20377b60b9ccde82517.jpg[/img]

There will be 4 characters in the game with whom it will be possible to dialogs a little with missions in a safe hub.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/f07d2783aafab70779e915f4901abba2fccf2ac9.jpg[/img]

And yes, now you can freely move around the game on a horse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/63daf80cba48320cd0509cd7a705cd7eef045249.gif[/img]

notes.title: Small question
notes.content:
Hi all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/fc79f7084b718e4f667fc678f157a01bb91c2235.jpg[/img]

It's been over a year since the game went into Early Access. During this period, there was little news from us, but now it is time to announce that:
1. The game moved to Unreal Engine 4,
2. Now the whole world will be in 3D,
3. Locations will become more detailed and interesting,
4. Hurricane gameplay will not go anywhere, but liters of blood and severed arms and legs will join it,
5. Improvement of the character, during the passage, you can upgrade the hero.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/nBFfQSq/imacowboy.gif[/img]

Release very soon, thanks for your support and for staying with us all this time, you are the best! :)
